transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I guess I’m here because things at my apartment have been bothering me. I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is, but I’m pretty sure some of the people there are watching when I come and go, and they’ve been slipping notes about me to the office. Other folks keep saying they’re just regular notices on the doors, but… it doesn’t feel that way to me. Does that make sense?

Have you had any thoughts or beliefs that others might find unusual or hard to believe, such as feeling like you have a special connection to events, people, or messages that others don’t seem to notice?

I mean… yeah, maybe. I don’t want to sound like I’m making trouble or anything, but I do feel like the people at my apartment are keeping track of when I come and go. And those notes on the doors… everybody tells me they’re just regular notices, but it really feels like they’re about me, like they’re being passed along to the office. I know that probably sounds odd.
Do you feel like certain events, actions, or communications are directed at you personally, even if others don’t see it that way?

Yeah… I do, I guess. Mostly with the apartment stuff. Like when there are notices on the doors, everybody says they’re just normal notices, and maybe that’s what they are, but it feels like they’re about me somehow. Like people there are watching when I leave and come back, and then passing notes about me to the office. I know that probably sounds strange… I’m not trying to make a big thing out of it.
Do you feel like things that are happening around you—like people talking, actions, or events—are specifically about you or directed at you, even if others don’t see it that way?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I’m accusing everybody, but at my apartment it really does feel like people are watching when I come and go. And those notes on the doors—everyone says they’re just regular notices, but to me it feels like they’re about me, like they’re getting passed along to the office. I know that may sound kind of odd, but that’s why I came in.

Outside of the apartment situation, have there been times when you felt like things people said, actions they took, or events happening around you were really about you, even if they didn’t seem that way to others?

Not really outside of that… at least, not that I can think of right now. It’s mostly the apartment thing that’s been bothering me. I came in because it really feels like the people there are watching when I come and go, and slipping notes about me to the office—even though everybody keeps telling me they’re just regular notices on the doors. I know how that sounds, but that’s the main thing.
Have you ever felt that things people do or say—like TV shows, songs, or conversations—are secretly about you or meant just for you, even if others don't see it that way?

Not with TV or songs so much… I don’t think so. It’s more the apartment thing, like I said. I came in because it really feels like the people there are watching when I leave and come back, and that they’re slipping notes about me to the office. Everybody keeps saying it’s just regular notices on the doors, and maybe I’m not explaining it right, but it feels personal to me.
